name: scan all log files for severity tokens
definition: glob the log files and total how many lines carry each of three severity tokens
failure_mode: missing severity variants like mixed-case or overlapping tokens change the total

name: serialize a full move trace as a board list to json
definition: Output the initial state, all intermediates, and the final state as row-string lists inside a json file.
failure_mode: missing or empty list, or a first state not matching the starter, fails

name: transform multiple csv inputs into a nested json graph
definition: ingest three CSV files and assemble an organization object with nested department objects each carrying its employees and projects arrays.
failure_mode: missing departments, too few employees, or duplicate ids fails structural tests

name: treat lowercase null/masked value markers in numeric data rows as absent data
definition: Ensure case-insensitive handling of sentinel null markers in parsed data rows so they map to masked values.
failure_mode: Lowercased null markers mis-parsed as text, breaking expected masked values
